subject: Geopolitics
title: Petrostates in Decline
description: A fast breakdown of Petrostates in Decline for builders.

hook.text: Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 plan aims to wean the kingdom off oil. Even the biggest producer sees the end coming.

buildup.text: As the world shifts to renewables, oil demand will peak and decline. Petrostates face existential budget crises.

discovery.text: Countries like Iraq, Algeria, and Angola depend on oil for over 80% of revenue. They have no Plan B.

twist.text: The transition will be slow, not instant. Oil demand could persist for decades in shipping, aviation, and chemicals.

climax.text: Petrostates must diversify now or collapse later. The window is open but closing. Few are moving fast enough.

punchline.text: An oil kingdom without a backup plan is a crisis waiting.

quiz.question: Why are petrostates at risk from the energy transition?
options: Most depend on oil for the vast majority of revenue
Their oil reserves are running out
